reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers all330lines, W1–W4/43431historical reader words, WPR9–WPR17 coverage, F1–F23, E1–E10, X1–X10, all20spot-check groups, search limits, exact remaining windows and K2/K3/K6/K8/K13 authoring cards. Initial combined output was truncated; the full document was recovered in three bounded ranges. Historical reader/spot-check/source-implemented labels and old test counts are not new raw-book reads, tests or gameplay. This pass's budget/worker limits are dated dispatch history, not current authorization or live workers.

F2: Source correction, not merely routing: X1/F6/spot-check7 mistook a provisional end-feast banner for final House Cup settlement. PDF-screen on the pinned compilation failed with an xref-object error; no clean extracted-text result is claimed. Visual reading of original PDFpages246–248 (printed245–247) shows the initial banner/standings, later awards, tie-breaking points and changed decorations. A final outcome cannot be initialized from the earlier banner. The original source remains unchanged and exact old report wording is preserved in amendments; this review adds only those three visually read pages, not a novel reread or edition authentication.

F3: Preserve units versus observations:17Sickles/29Knuts/493conversion is a located prior source finding; individual quotes, basket totals, wages, prize/reward/fine and donation flows are different economic facts. The train armful is not a per-snack price. Differing newspaper fares may depend on context/edition or another unresolved cause; US/UK spelling clues do not prove that edition caused the price difference. Zero hits for tuition/fees and selected lodging/healer windows are search limits, not proof all school/hospital/lodging services are free or every cost is equipment. Named fees need actual source or an authored label. Mixed-edition provenance remains hypothesis; page tags are not printed page numbers.

F4: Keep the source roles and separate gates: institution jurisdiction, actual witnesses, underage magic detection versus actor attribution, stated law versus enforcement and emergency exception, wand custody/use/fit versus registration, guardian form versus age, teacher-specific NEWT threshold versus general grade, skill versus job admission, permission versus room access and debt versus trust. A teacher's life-sentence statement, Dumbledore's jurisdiction claim, reader-only floor/role/notice reports and the actual hearing outcome have different evidence levels. The Trace's report of magic near minors is not an infallible actor identity. E1–E10 remain proposed engine defaults with local era/person/location/enforcer dials, not universal hard bans or complete wizarding law.

F5: Dated only-Polyjuice/no-cast/no-school/no-denomination claims are superseded as current whole-HP statements by the live Harry lead plan's W1–W4 and holdings receipts. Current hpLeadHoldingsReaders reads the actual player's resource under the pack currency ladder separately from other holders. That source seam and receipt statuses do not prove every school day, grade, timetable, canon cast, Ministry system or ordinary start. Keep the old Polyjuice slice's authored coins and local people separate from Harry's actual lead seat and source-grounded W4 currency/wand records. The nursery, student, trader and other lives remain compatible proposals; current PROJECT keeps Harry alongside Klein and does not reinstate the retired prestige gate.

F6: Preserve useful daily rhythm, post/notice/result surfaces, named staff with duties, priced goods, changing passwords, remembered consequences and source-backed law/tool/grade distinctions through the existing HP owners. WA6 readiness cards and proposed smallest slices are not AD43 completion or a replacement build order. Native first-person learning needs learned/useful consumers, actual access/custody, age/body, state settlement and fresh proof; a role label or paragraph is insufficient. Train/first term/shop/dueling/Ministry/decree/exam/Apparition/late-story/supplemental gaps keep their exact stated scopes until later qualified evidence resolves them. No source PDF is altered, no gameplay/source code/test/build/browser/private save/worker/acquisition/delete/move/commit/push occurs.

reviews.classification: dated coverage, source interpretation and current owner boundaries reconciled
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual review covers all325lines including the later W5 money census, four historical windows/47584words,28spot-check groups, all role/place/money/time/power rows, F1–F10, EF1–EF7, C1–C8, exact unread windows and K2/K3/K6/K8/K13cards. A truncated initial output's spot-check middle was recovered in bounded rereads. The full-book dossier, this window pass, targeted opens, regex census, later W5 and current source/receipts are different evidence units. No whole804945word reread or new book acquisition follows.

F2: Certification, physical badge, commercial licence/permit, academy vouching, mana-keyed access, personal source, rod fuel/control, learned shaping and rank differ. Mentor headcount quota differs from weekly meetings; a class representative's15minute demand is not automatically academy policy. Offers have actor motives and local supply: tutoring clears a detective's quota, field work seeks a team member, household/lab access trades actual means, and rural rewards can be goods. Neither one four-person job nor one instructor's practice estimate defines a universal capacity or gate. Preserve learned control, fuel and useful task consumers rather than copying a bare mana bar or reverse-engineering a universal1/8cast cost from eight observed shots.

F3: Haslush's detective identity is directly confirmed in c015p46–47 of the existing EPUB-derived paragraph file; the current PEOPLE dossier already calls him detective, so C1's old one-word repair request is not an outstanding task there. c010p16–18 directly supports knowing a learned rain barrier after a restart and the distinction between several known designs and one actually castable method; it does not establish every retained ability or a whole reset algorithm. Royal Academy naming remains the located earlier source correction, not a new source authentication. Alternate paragraph schemes need their own crosswalk, not a fixed offset. EF8 was referenced without being defined; the enumerated law list is EF1–EF7 plus a separate inferred incentives pattern.

F4: No currency name found by the listed searches is narrower than no currency name anywhere. Authored crowns and pack prices stay authored; a badge's fraction of one person's savings is not a universal price. The500silver travel quote, barter basket, classroom budget and unknown rent/fees have different contexts. W5 adds specific transport cost/time/border and money-convertibility observations but leaves c085/tuition/aftermath windows open. Its phrase no trade house/tariff or every price cannot be elevated to whole-book absence from those searches. Keep every unresolved quantity explicit; neither an inventory count nor a missing word licenses a source price.

F5: Source loop holder, authored independent guest, source-scened seat, shared restart readout and actual reset execution are distinct. The current world brief preserves a continuous retained visitor branch and later bounded exploration proof. The current pack also contains a Zorian-seat class record with explicit class-knowledge-only/no-spell-learned text; that does not prove a full canonical loop controller or give the independent guest a mana source. Old no-schedules/no-restart/no-technique statements remain dated coverage at the pass's scope, not current whole-pack absence. Actual access helper separates retained skill from grant status; rank/badge rights cannot be conferred by another person's memories or by a UI label. PROJECT's lead sequence and retired milestone qualify the old next-list deferral; no new world build or reader is selected here.

F6: Preserve source-local institutional incentive, points requirement, library triage, personal key, instructor contract, method/fuel/control, household privacy, merchant discretion, source-vs-authored price and within-loop savings ideas in existing world/domain owners. Unknown curfew/hours/calendar, licensing exceptions, bank/fees, mana cost/regeneration, travel/customs, late aftermath, special mind/soul/body and [S]core gaps remain bounded. Only the two selected EPUB paragraph ranges were newly read; secrecy-sensitive details are not disclosed or promoted. Authoring floor cards do not prove runtime, natural routes, persistence or human review. No runtime/schema/source-code edit, new tests/build/browser/save access, acquisition, worker, deletion, relocation, commit or push occurs.
